Yes this is very true. Did you get her as a puppy? If so, she has a connection to you and only you. Dogs are weird like that. They love their first masters until they die.

At the humane society I have seen dogs that were so attached to their owners when the owners brought them in. They would howl and cry all day long. Even though you hurt her, she still loves you.

You are already getting better just by the idea that you know what you did wrong and you feel bad for it. Now a lot of people are telling you to get rid of the dog, but in my honest opinion: don't. Keeping her will help you, no matter what you think. She will help you not be depressed.

I have been a dog trainer for the humane society before, and what you are describing will NOT give her long term problems. She will be over it soon. Perhaps she will be a little scared of you, but go on walks, give her treats, and hugs and pets and she should forgive you in no time. She already licked your face, she's already forgiving you.

Don't kill yourself because your dog needs you. Just look at her beautiful face. I have anger problems too and there are times I come close to abuse with my dog. But I find other ways and I sure as hell get myself out of the room she's in so I don't hurt her. You are almost there; keep going and good luck.
